Tanning on Worle High Street

Lay-down and stand-up sunbeds, plus all the creams you need. You’ll find us at 112 High Street, Worle.

Whether you’re topping up a holiday tan or starting from scratch, we’ll help you build up the colour you want without overdoing it. We’re open six days a week, and till 8 on Thursdays if you can’t make it in the day.

Open Monday to Saturday, and till 8 on Thursdays.

Prices Directions

The beds

Ergoline lay-downs

Proper salon beds with a face tanner built into the head end. Lie back and have a break for a few minutes.

The canopy comes down over you, so you tan front and back at the same time. Comfy, relaxing, and an easy one to start with if you’re new to sunbeds.

Tecnosole stand-up

If you’d rather stand, the Y-Sun booth tans you all the way round. Nothing pressing on your skin, so no white patches.

It’s quick to get in and out of, which makes it handy if you’re on your lunch break or just want to be in and out.

Special offers

Buy your minutes up front and they work out cheaper. Ask at the desk for single session prices.

The bigger the bundle, the less each minute costs, so if you’re a regular the 120 minutes is the one to go for. Not sure? Tell us how often you’re planning to come in and we’ll point you to the right one.

Creams

Sachets are one use, so they’re a good way to try a cream out. We’ve got bigger bottles in the cabinet too.

Not sure which to pick? Go To Black is made to take you several shades darker in one go. Non Stop Black keeps working after you’ve finished your session. 24K Carrot Oil is packed with beta-carotene, and Ultima Quad Hybrid is a 24 hour accelerator with added vitamin D. Ask us and we’ll help you choose.

Good to know

You have to be 18 or over to use a sunbed. That’s the law, so we may ask for ID.

Never been on a sunbed before? Have a word with us at the desk and we’ll tell you how long to go on for.

Always wear goggles, and leave at least 48 hours between sessions.

For the best results, take off any make-up before your session and give your skin a scrub the day before so the colour goes on evenly. Moisturise afterwards to help your tan last longer.

Some medicines can make your skin more sensitive to UV. If you’re taking anything, check with us or your pharmacist first.

There are cold drinks in the fridge for after.
